Punjabi Lassi
By: miansari66
Published: Thursday, November 4, 2010 - 11:27pm

Ingredients




1 Yoghurt 250 (ml)
2 Black pepper whole 2- 3 Nos
3 Green Cardamom 1 -2 Nos
4 Sugar 2- 3 teaspoon(Or according to your taste)
5 Ice cold water ½ cup
6 Ice cubes 5- 6 Nos

Preparation

1 Put all the ingredients in an electric blender, and blend at high speed for 3-5 minutes. 2 Pour in a glass and enjoy the real taste of Punjab. 3 Punjab is a province of Pakistan)

About


Punjabi Lassi is a refreshing drink for humid and hot weather.
